title: Los miedos de la torre y sus habilidades
description: docs/quests/nuria.md § Monsters, docs/combat.md § Habilidades de los miedos. Each foe of Uri's tower showing its ability in the fight tester (Gerard in Matemágico, Aitor in Papagato, free maná, no PV lost): the escort of ring 3, La Cebolla y los suyos, over four rounds (Pelada and Capa nueva, Transparente, Carrerilla with its chip naming the target, «GAME OVER», Aplastón); a platito's Darle la vuelta in a ring-2 pack; El Plato's surprise dish and its ¡Puaj!. No ability is named when it is used (no card over the foe, nothing under its damage number): what it does shows in the scene. Run it with --gpu.

steps.caption: Ring 3's fear, La Cebolla y los suyos: La Cebolla with four layers, a fantasmita counting down and a cebollita (the fight tester: Gerard and Aitor, free maná, no PV lost)
Several foes standing: the prompt says «Elige un enemigo.»
Aitor's blow took the cebollita's only layer: its plate says Pelada (its next turn it grows one back)
Round 1, the foes' turn: La Cebolla's Peso (everyone cries), the fantasmita's Atravesar («2…»), and Capa nueva: the cebollita wraps itself in a cream layer, with no name over it
Round 2: on its last count the fantasmita goes Transparente (50 % alpha, scanlines): physical blows go through it
Round 3: La Cebolla takes its run-up, Carrerilla (it rolls back and wobbles, violet streaks at whom it looks), and the fantasmita's «GAME OVER» blast hits everyone
Its plate chip names who it will fall on: Carrerilla → name
Round 4: Aplastón on the one it looked at, a ground shockwave with chips (braced by Defender)
